metrics: boundary flags before and after candidate support, never correctness
Top1/5/6/10/32 exact source presence with all failure states

native.binding: Commit exact new requests, source profile and code/identity hashes before execution. No retries/replacements.
native.over_budget: Publish a measured budget blocker, execute no partial new selection, preserve every unmeasured target.
native.reuse: Authenticate fixed #33 train candidate receipts and #49 original annotation receipts by reading/identity only.

policy.candidate: All 93973 inputs before candidate selection. Same authenticated research top32 snapshots and top6 prefix. Exact source presence at 1/5/6/10/32, existing candidate_evidence conditions; missing/rejected/failed/unattempted remain explicit, not certified empty lists.
policy.consumers: Separately authorized source/contrast/candidate audit only. No training, numeric cache, body pretraining, model inference, checkpoint reuse, or independent evaluation.
policy.contrast: Existing conservative witnesses: two literal source forms with two contexts each, four distinct source components; at most one quartet per reading and at most 32 form types. Not maximum capacity or semantic certification. Report document witnesses separately.
policy.labels: Original base/raw annotation and exact bounded left context unchanged. training_eligible and independent_gold_eligible remain false.
policy.observations: Character classes immediately outside the original base, annotation kind, explicit historical-kana markers, and existing review flags. These are descriptive prompts, never linguistic validity or rejection rules. No right context is passed to a model or used to guess input/suffix/reading.
policy.scope: Only the verified #53 permitted original paragraph inputs. All original exclusions and slots remain immutable.
